source: NCERT Class XII, Contemporary World Politics, Ch. 6 (International Organisations).

sections.heading: 1. Why International Organisations?
points: **International organisations** help nations **cooperate, resolve disputes, and address common problems** (war, poverty, disease, climate).
They are **not a world government** but a mechanism for **collective action and rule-making**.
They help avoid war and manage globalisation.

sections.heading: 2. The United Nations (UN)
points: The **UN** was founded in **1945** (after WWII) to maintain **international peace and security** (successor to the League of Nations).

sub: **Security Council** — responsible for peace; **5 permanent members (USA, UK, France, Russia, China)** with **veto power** + 10 non-permanent.
**Secretariat** (headed by the **Secretary-General**), **International Court of Justice (ICJ)**, **Economic and Social Council (ECOSOC)**, and the (now-inactive) Trusteeship Council.

sections.heading: 3. UN Agencies and Reform
points: Specialised agencies: **WHO, UNESCO, UNICEF, ILO, IMF, World Bank, FAO**, etc.
**Reform of the UN** — demands to make the **Security Council more representative** (India, Brazil, Germany, Japan — the G4 — seek permanent seats).
Reform of structures and processes is debated (veto, membership).

sections.heading: 4. Other Organisations
points: **IMF** (balance of payments, monetary stability) and the **World Bank** (development finance) — the Bretton Woods institutions.
**WTO** — regulates international trade.
**IAEA** (nuclear), **Amnesty International, Human Rights Watch** (NGOs).
These influence global economic and political affairs.

sections.heading: 5. High-Yield One-Liners (Last-Minute Recall)
points: UN founded 1945 (successor to the League of Nations).
Security Council: 5 permanent members (USA, UK, France, Russia, China) with veto + 10 non-permanent.
Organs: General Assembly, Security Council, Secretariat, ICJ, ECOSOC.
G4 (India, Brazil, Germany, Japan) seek permanent UNSC seats.
IMF + World Bank = Bretton Woods institutions; WTO = trade.

sections.heading: 6. Common Traps (Watch Out)
points: The **5 permanent UNSC members (USA, UK, France, Russia, China)** hold the **veto**.
The **UN was founded in 1945** (after WWII).
The **ICJ** is the UN's principal **judicial** organ.
**IMF and World Bank** are the **Bretton Woods** institutions.
